title: Tailwise Training Terms of Withdrawal and Refund
content:
Only the customer can withdraw a dog from a Tailwise Training course or pack. On withdrawal the enrollment closes as withdrawn, the refund below is paid, and the unused sessions are removed from the enrollment.

## Refund terms

1. **Before the first session.** The refund is the full price paid, where the course refunds in full before start.
2. **Group course after start.** A group course withdrawn before the course's prorated-refund session number is refunded the unused sessions' share of the price paid, less the course's refund administration fee. Later withdrawals are not refunded.
3. **Private pack after start.** A private pack is refunded the course's refund rate per unused session, multiplied by the number of unused sessions, less the course's refund administration fee, never below 0.00.
4. **Guarantee repeat.** A guarantee repeat has no refund.

Unused sessions are the sessions still available on the enrollment at withdrawal, that is, sessions credited at enrollment that have not been attended, forfeited or otherwise booked out. The unused sessions' share of the price paid is the price paid multiplied by the number of unused sessions and divided by the sessions credited at enrollment. The price paid is the amount the customer paid for the enrollment. The full-refund term, the prorated-refund session number, the per-session rate and the administration fee are each course's own figures in the Tailwise Training withdrawal refund schedule.

## Which term applies

| Enrollment | When the customer withdraws | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Group course | Before the first session | Full price paid (term 1) |
| Group course | After the first session and before the prorated-refund session number | Unused sessions' share of the price paid, less the administration fee (term 2) |
| Group course | At or after the prorated-refund session number | None (term 2) |
| Private pack | Before the first session | Full price paid (term 1) |
| Private pack | After start | Rate per unused session times the unused sessions, less the administration fee, not below 0.00 (term 3) |
| Guarantee repeat | Any time | None (term 4) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical prices, rates and fees, for illustration only)

**Group course, prorated.** Price paid 120.00; 6 sessions credited; withdrawn after session 1 and before the prorated-refund session, with 5 sessions unused; administration fee 10.00. The unused share is 120.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by 6, which is 100.00. Less the fee of 10.00, the refund is 90.00.

**Group course, before start.** The same course withdrawn before the first session: the refund is the full 120.00 paid.

**Private pack, unused sessions.** Rate 50.00 per unused session; administration fee 20.00; 3 sessions unused. 50.00 multiplied by 3 is 150.00; less 20.00, the refund is 130.00.

**Private pack, floor.** Same rate and fee, no sessions unused. 50.00 multiplied by 0 is 0.00; less 20.00 would fall below zero, so the refund is 0.00.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a withdrawal be made on the customer's behalf?** No. Only the customer can withdraw.

**Is the administration fee withheld before the course starts?** Term 1 refunds the full price paid before the first session; the administration fee is withheld from a refund after the first session.

**What does a guarantee repeat return on withdrawal?** Nothing. A guarantee repeat has no refund.
